mechanism: Nafcillin, a beta-lactam antibiotic, may potentiate amikacin's nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through additive renal damage and enhanced aminoglycoside accumulation in proximal tubular cells.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and auditory function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin and dose adjustment based on renal clearance.
